comparisons.label: Investigation context
comparisons.detail: 2 investigations selected: hardware, environment and reporting conventions differ.

comparisons.label: Material and geometry
comparisons.detail: 2 material families and 2 geometries selected. Parsed from free text; not a controlled material specification.

comparisons.label: Total pressure
comparisons.detail: No selected record reports total pressure. Oxygen partial pressure cannot be computed, and atmospheric equivalence cannot be established.

comparisons.label: Gravity at test level
comparisons.detail: Gravity is investigation-level context only. No selected record has a measured g-level, so gravity cannot be treated as a controlled comparison variable.

comparisons.label: Oxygen measurement basis
comparisons.detail: 2 of 2 selected records report an initial O2 value. BASS-II uses a constant-offset sensor correction. Saffire-I retains a reported range midpoint or approximate single value.

comparisons.label: Flow measurement basis
comparisons.detail: Flow bases differ: BASS-II uses a slow-response duct display; Saffire-I reports a flow setting. The two are not the same instrument quantity.

comparisons.label: Ignition reporting
comparisons.detail: 1 of 2 selected records report ignition power. Ignition method is not stated in either table.

comparisons.label: Standardized outcome
comparisons.detail: Neither table contains a standardized extinction or sustained-burning classification. Burn duration is not equivalent to a flammability outcome.

limitations: Investigation-level context; not a per-test measurement.
The current corpus contains BASS-II (129 records) and Saffire-I (2 records). It is not the whole of NASA combustion research.
Total pressure is absent from both PSI experimental tables; no cabin pressure was substituted.
Gravity is investigation-level only (ISS/Cygnus microgravity), not a per-test measured g-level.
Neither table contains a standardized extinction/sustained-burning outcome.
BASS-II flow values are slow-response displays; Saffire-I reports a setting. The BASS-II derived velocity uses one factor, not a per-test calibration.
O2 readings were corrected by a constant offset because the sensor was out of calibration; per-sample uncertainty is not supplied.
Material family, geometry and dimensions are parsed from free-text fields and marked derived.
Two BASS-II final-O2 values exceed their initial values by more than 2 percentage points and are flagged suspect, not corrected.
No partial-gravity experiment records are included. The official challenge states PSI currently has none; LUCI is included only as context.
No AI-generated scientific claims are presented. The evidence assistant is a deterministic retrieval and citation engine.
Collection membership does not establish experimental equivalence. Descriptive coverage counts do not average unlike quantities.
Missing fields refer to the normalized record layer; reports elsewhere may contain context not linked to individual rows. Review original notes and unreported per-value uncertainty.
disclaimer: FIRETRACE-generated research product from selected corpus records, not an untouched NASA original. Not a comprehensive review of NASA combustion research. Does not predict fire behavior, certify material safety, establish spacecraft fire-safety compliance, or imply NASA endorsement.
